description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the Mattermost automation dashboard API, including starting cycles, fetching specs, recording results, updating cycles, and uploading screenshots.

methods.name: createAndStartCycle
methods.description: Starts a new testing cycle by sending a POST request to the dashboard API.

methods.name: getSpecToTest
methods.description: Fetches the specification to test from the dashboard API based on repository, branch, build, and server info.

methods.name: recordSpecResult
methods.description: Records the results of a test specification to the dashboard API.

methods.name: updateCycle
methods.description: Updates a testing cycle with new data via a PUT request.

methods.name: uploadScreenshot
methods.description: Uploads a screenshot file to the dashboard and returns the object URL.
